title: Strategic Research and Development Investment Decisions in the Pharmaceutical Industry
eligible_reason: Dynamic structural model of pharmaceutical R&D entry/continuation/exit (CCP estimation with unobserved market types); reduced-form fixed-effects logits of continue/enter decisions on competitor counts by phase. No staggered binary treatment, no DiD.
design_notes: Part2 do-file (Tables 4-5): xtlogit action_cont / action_ent on counts of competitors by phase, year and company dummies, fe. Part3 MATLAB structural estimation; Part4 counterfactuals.
data_files_note: Readme: Adis R&D Insight data are proprietary; SimulatedData.csv and Simulated_4firms.txt are 'artificial data ... no relation to the actual data'.
data_provenance_note: Artificial data for the reduced-form and structural steps.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
